proposals.source: Q4 2026 guidance in 10-Q filed 2026-10-30; net sales expected between $240.0B and $247.0B, or growth of 12% to 16% vs Q4 2025.
proposals.justification: Explicit management net sales growth guidance for Q4 2026. Current point estimate of 11.7% is below the guided range. FX headwind of approximately 60 bps is already included.
proposals.uncertainty: Guidance range; subject to macro, FX, holiday demand, and online/cloud growth risks.

proposals.source: Q4 2026 guidance in 10-Q filed 2026-10-30: operating income $28.5B to $33.5B; net sales $240B to $247B.
proposals.justification: Implied Q4 2026 operating margin range is $28.5B/$247B to $33.5B/$240B, or about 11.5% to 14.0%. This is above the current 9.4% assumption.
proposals.uncertainty: Derived from guidance; excludes energy derivative remeasurements, acquisitions, restructurings, and legal settlements.

proposals.source: 10-Q filed 2026-10-30: 'We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion.'
proposals.justification: Explicit 2026 cash capex guidance of about $220B. The current 13.7% capex intensity would imply roughly $1.6T of 2026 revenue, which is inconsistent with Q4 2026 net sales guidance of $240B to $247B. Using the Q4 sales run-rate or plausible 2026 revenue implies a capex intensity closer to roughly 22% to 30%.
proposals.uncertainty: High; full-year 2026 revenue is not disclosed in the selected excerpts, so the revenue denominator is an interpretation. Capex classification and cash timing also matter.

proposals.source: 10-Q filed 2026-10-30: long-dated contractual obligations greater than $100B over 10 years, including AWS chip obligations.
proposals.justification: No explicit management guidance on the model transition period. Retained at 5 years; long-dated AWS chip and energy commitments could support a longer transition, but contract duration is not a direct margin-fade input.
proposals.uncertainty: High; no company guidance on transition period.

proposals.source: Q4 2026 implied operating margin range of about 11.5% to 14.0%; no explicit ROIC guidance provided.
proposals.justification: No direct company disclosure on mature incremental ROIC. Retained at 12%; the Q4 2026 operating margin guidance brackets the current assumption, but ROIC also depends on invested capital and capex productivity.
proposals.uncertainty: High; dependent on future capex productivity, AWS margin mix, and could be lower if large AI-related capex requires time to generate returns.

proposals.source: 10-Q excerpts (2026-10-28): no revenue guidance provided; MD&A discusses liquidity/capital resources only.
proposals.justification: No explicit top-line guidance or updated revenue drivers in the provided excerpts, so no evidence-backed basis to change the current assumption.

proposals.source: 10-Q excerpts (2026-10-28): tax/OECD global minimum tax discussion; no operating margin guidance.
proposals.justification: Excerpts discuss tax positions and potential tax burden increases, but do not provide operating margin guidance; tax items mostly affect taxes below operating income, so no basis to adjust.

proposals.source: 10-Q MD&A (2026-10-28): liquidity sufficient for 'material capital expenditures'; debt proceeds may fund capital expenditures.
proposals.justification: MD&A indicates capital expenditures remain material and funding is available, but gives no precise capex intensity guidance; retaining current assumption is most consistent with the disclosed investment posture.

proposals.source: 10-Q excerpts (2026-10-28): no transition-period guidance or change in investment horizon disclosed.
proposals.justification: No evidence in provided excerpts to alter the assumed transition horizon.
